name: Moctezuma
title: The Conqueror
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The greatest Aztec Emperor who expanded his kingdom and made Tenochtitlan the jewel of his world. Empowered by the divine aether released after the Shattering, Moctezuma has become akin to a god. He is one of Omeyocan’s staunchest defenders, wary of other Realms and determined to protect his people against invasion.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If an ally is defeated, activate this hero’s Core Ability.
Increase the [Shield] limit to 50,000 and reflects 100% of the damage inflicted to the shield. This will always be a Normal hit and ignore 100% DEF.

skills.name: Obsidian Judgement
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 10%HP+70%ATK 2 times. Each hit inflicts 50% increased damage to [Barrier] and [Shield]. If the target is not under [Barrier] and [Shield] increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 10% instead.

skills.name: Moctezuma’s Revenge
skills.description:
Attack all enemies 5%HP+55%ATK 2 times. Before each hit, has a 75% chance to remove [Barrier] and [Shield] from each target.

If the target is not under [Barrier] or [Shield] after attacking, has a 75% chance to place [Curse II] on each target for 2 turns otherwise place [Acid] on each target for 2 turns.

Also place [Taunt] on each target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sacrificial Vow
skills.description: When an enemy attacks an ally, decrease the damage received by 20% and increase the damage this hero inflicts on their next ability by 5%. This is doubled if the enemy is under [Barrier] or [Shield].

awakening_bonuses.description: If an ally is defeated, activate this hero’s Core Ability.

skills.description: Place [Ward] on all allies for 2 turns, then attack all enemies 10%HP+100%ATK. Also place [Shield] on all allies equal to 30% of the damage inflicted. The [Shield] cannot exceed 25,000.
